livingCosts.notes: ANU 'Estimated Cost of Living in Canberra' (2026), weekly figures x 52/12, range midpoints. Housing: accommodation $312 (share) to $673 (not sharing) + utilities $22-$71 per week. Food: groceries $146-$204/wk. Transport: $5-$30/wk. Personal: phone and internet $18-$26/wk, textbooks $1,531-$1,595/yr, clothing $214-$1,000 and shoes $60-$100 per 6 months, haircut $20-$82/month. Excludes GP visits and childcare. ANU's headline is AU$33,000-$39,000 a year (AU$634-$750/wk), or AU$24,000-$28,500 for the Feb-Nov academic year.
